subject: Req131: hiring closure and band reallocation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: REQ131 — summary + recommendation for closure and band reuse

Team,

Thanks for carving out time this morning. After reviewing the interview feedback, salary expectations, and projected ramp time, I recommend we close Req131 for now and reallocate the headcount to two FY27 initiatives where time-to-impact looks higher. Key bullets: 
- Candidate quality: consistent strengths on system design but several red flags on cross-team leadership and stakeholder influence; not a clear senior hire.
- Compensation band: expected comp was above the target band for the role; shifting the band to a narrower senior IC band would increase cycle time and limit candidate volume.
- Business priority: Data Platform roadmap needs faster delivery; redeploying this slot to a mid-senior data infra hire will yield clearer ROI.

Attachments: Req131_comp_eval.pdf (panel summary), candidate-scorecards.zip (raw scorecards).

Ask: please reply with ACK or objections by EOD Monday. If no objections, I will notify People Ops and external recruiters, close the req in Workday, and propose two reclassification options: (A) split into one mid-senior data infra req + one stretch engineer for infra-tooling, or (B) convert to two headcount credits for Q2 prioritization.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-16T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: REQ131 — summary + recommendation for closure and band reuse

Rishi — ACK to close and reallocate. I reviewed the scorecards and agree the pool hasn't produced a strong enough candidate for the senior bar. My only ask: if we split the headcount, ensure both new reqs have clear success metrics and interview rubrics to avoid another long cycle.

If you want, I can put together a short rubric template for the data infra role and get it to People Ops.

Thanks,
Lauren
VP, Engineering Recruiting
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-17T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: REQ131 — summary + recommendation for closure and band reuse

Thanks — ACK from People Ops side. Once we have the decision recorded, I'll: 
- Close Req131 in Workday and change status to 'Cancelled — Business Decision'
- Work with HRAgency on cancelling active outreach and handling candidate comms (Tom Reyes thread below)
- Draft a reclassification request form for you to approve (will include proposed band and hiring rubric)

Note: we'll need an approved headcount redistribution form for finance for Q2 planning. I'll prep the template and route it to Finance.

Marissa
Sr. People Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-17T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: REQ131 — summary + recommendation for closure and band reuse

ACK. One small operational note: if we choose option (A) to split into two reqs, hiring routing for one of them (infra-tooling) should be set to a dedicated panel that includes Product and Security reviewers — otherwise we'll see delays. Happy to coordinate the panel invitations.

Grace
Director, Talent Partnering
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, HRAgency <talent@hraagency.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T16:43:00-08:00
Subject: REQ131 — final: closing req and next steps (candidate comms + reallocation)

Marissa / HRAgency —
Per the committee ACKs, we're closing Req131 effective today. Actions I'm sending now: 
1) Marissa: please close the req in Workday as 'Cancelled — Business Decision' and route the headcount reallocation form to Finance (tagging Vivek).
2) HRAgency: please pause outreach and send a closure note to active candidates; draft below for Tom Reyes: "Thank you for your time; we will not be moving forward with this role but will keep your info for future opportunities."
3) Lauren: when you have the rubrics ready, please share the template so we can attach to the reclassification request.

I'll file the committee notes to the hiring drive (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Req131-evals) and mark Req131 as closed. If Finance needs a short justification memo, I'll prepare a one-page rationale summarizing expected ROI for the reallocation.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Rishi
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
